title: GPUHour — Live Cloud GPU Price Comparison
excerpt: Compare live cloud GPU rental prices across marketplaces, GPU clouds and hyperscalers — H100, H200, B200, RTX 4090 and more, spot and on-demand, refreshed from provider APIs.
content_html:
Live Cloud GPU Prices, Every Provider

Compare live GPU rental prices across clouds and marketplaces — pulled from provider APIs, not stale pricing pages.

4097 live offers 8 providers polled by API 51 providers tracked 77 GPU models

Cheapest live configuration per GPU per provider. Prices are whole-instance USD per hour divided by GPU count; click through for full configs. Data is polled from provider APIs every few hours.

Prices straight from provider APIs

No hand-maintained spreadsheets: offers are pulled from each cloud's own pricing API on a rolling schedule, with the fetch time stored per offer.

Marketplaces and clouds side by side

Vast.ai and Clore rigs next to RunPod, Verda, Vultr and the hyperscalers — spot and on-demand, consumer and datacenter silicon.

Free JSON API

Everything in this table is available at /api/v1/offers/ as JSON — filter by GPU, provider or pricing type.

小贩

每个提供商的每个 GPU 最便宜的实时配置。 价格为整个实例每小时美元除以 GPU 数量；单击查看完整配置。 每隔几个小时从提供商 API 轮询一次数据。

价格直接来自提供商 API

无需手动维护电子表格：报价是按滚动时间表从每个云自己的定价 API 中提取的，并存储每个报价的获取时间。

市场和云并肩
